name: Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd
title: Waaree Renewable Technologies Ltd - 534618 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR1,102 cr (+131% YoY) and FY26 execution of 2,727 MWp, but order book fell to 2.83 GW and management gave no numeric guidance, with margin defended only by a 'around 15%' threshold.

capex.quote: whatever the capex which is existing by 54 megawatt plus 227 megawatt which we have mentioned and presented

triggers.label: Order inflow ~2.3 GW vs 2.4 GW prior year
triggers.quote: Like previous financial year order inflow was 2.4 gigawatt and this time it was 2.3 gigawatt, slight decrease, 5%.

triggers.label: Receivables more than doubled
triggers.quote: Because from 500 to now the double, more than doubled?

triggers.label: Margin threshold 'around 15%'
triggers.quote: the EBITDA margin should remain around 15%, but definitely we are delivering on a continuous basis.

triggers.label: IPP build-out 227 MWp, self-funded
triggers.quote: these projects are necessary as of now it is funded; is under construction, is funded through internal accruals only.

guidance.value: not quantified; order book 2.8 GW executed over 12-15 months
guidance.quote: that we are going to execute in next quarters which we mentioned 12 to 15 months

red_flags.label: Order book down YoY (3.2 GW to 2.8 GW)
red_flags.quote: The order book has declined from 3.2 gigawatt to 2.8 gigawatt on a Y-o-Y basis as March versus March.

red_flags.label: Receivables and inventory build
red_flags.quote: there is significant increase in trade receivables and inventory in the balance sheet

red_flags.label: Q4 execution sharply lower, mix-driven
red_flags.quote: Now, this quarter execution is because of the variety of order which I am executing.

evasions.quote: maybe like what you said is correct. It can contribute, but it is difficult to quantify how much is on each count.
it cannot be said like this particular segment has a higher margin.
So, when it gets consolidated, so I will not be able to comment
